notes: Overall good quality. Unified spellings: انټرنېټ (was mixed with انټرنیټ), ټیلیفون (was mixed with تلیفون), پناه ځای for shelter (kiosk used سرپناه), wifi in Latin. 'Switch on' rendered as فعال کول instead of روښانه (light). Shower/wash step uses لمبل instead of مینځل (washing things). Fixed guess.p 'Not here?', wa.msg verb tense, menu.what agreement, wel.city (was addressed to the app), duplicated words in im.s4 and geo.d.fix, hours 'نه پېژنو' -> 'نه پوهېږو', report wording, polite ستاسو for organisations. Plurals one/other filled with proper singular forms.
